                           0.99)
     --trainer.optim.centered
                           Compute centered RMSprop, gradient normalized by its
                           variance (default: False)
     --trainer.optim.lr-decay LR_DECAY
                           Learning rate decay in AdaGrad optimizer (type: float,
                           default: 1e-06)
     --trainer.optim.init-acc-val INIT_ACC_VAL
                           Init accum value in Adagrad (type: float, default: 0)
     --trainer.optim.max-iter MAX_ITER
                           max iterations in LBFGS (type: int, default: 20)

     --trainer.lrsched.lrsch-type {none,exp_lr,invpow_lr,cos_lr,adamcos_lr,red_lr_on_plateau,noam_lr,triangular_lr}
                           Learning rate scheduler type (e.g., exp_lr, invpow_lr,
                           cos_lr, adamcos_lr, red_lr_on_plateau, noam_lr,
                           triangular_lr). (type: <method 'lower' of 'str'
                           objects>, default: none)
     --trainer.lrsched.decay-rate DECAY_RATE
                           Exponential decay factor applied every decay_steps.
                           (type: float, default: 0.01)
     --trainer.lrsched.decay-steps DECAY_STEPS
                           Number of steps between exponential decays. (type:
                           int, default: 100)
     --trainer.lrsched.power POWER
                           Exponent for inverse power decay (lr ~ step^-power).
                           (type: float, default: 0.5)
     --trainer.lrsched.hold-steps HOLD_STEPS
                           Number of steps to hold the initial lr before decay.
                           (type: int, default: 10)
     --trainer.lrsched.t T
                           Cycle length for cosine/triangular schedules (in
                           steps). (type: int, default: 10)
     --trainer.lrsched.t-mul T_MUL
                           Cycle length multiplier after each restart
                           (cos/triangular). (type: int, default: 1)
     --trainer.lrsched.gamma GAMMA
                           Max lr multiplier after each restart (cos/triangular).
                           (type: float, default: 1.0)
     --trainer.lrsched.warm-restarts, --no_trainer.lrsched.warm-restarts
                           Enable warm restarts in cosine schedules. (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --trainer.lrsched.monitor MONITOR
                           Metric name to monitor for ReduceLROnPlateau.
                           (default: val_loss)
     --trainer.lrsched.mode {min,max}
                           Whether lower or higher metric is better for plateau
                           reduction. (default: min)
     --trainer.lrsched.factor FACTOR
                           Multiply lr by this factor when plateau reduction
                           triggers. (type: float, default: 0.1)
     --trainer.lrsched.patience PATIENCE
                           Epochs with no improvement before reducing lr. (type:
                           int, default: 10)
     --trainer.lrsched.threshold THRESHOLD
                           Minimum change to qualify as an improvement. (type:
                           float, default: 0.0001)
     --trainer.lrsched.threshold_mode {rel,abs}
                           Use relative or absolute threshold for improvements.
                           (default: rel)
     --trainer.lrsched.cooldown COOLDOWN
                           Epochs to wait after a reduction before resuming
                           checks. (type: int, default: 0)
     --trainer.lrsched.eps EPS
                           Minimum lr change; smaller updates are ignored. (type:
                           float, default: 1e-08)
     --trainer.lrsched.min-lr MIN_LR
                           Lower bound for learning rate. (type: float, default:
                           0)
     --trainer.lrsched.warmup-steps WARMUP_STEPS
                           Steps to linearly warm up lr from 0 to the base value.
                           (type: int, default: null)
     --trainer.lrsched.d-model D_MODEL
                           Transformer model dimension for Noam schedule. (type:
                           int, default: null)
     --trainer.lrsched.lr-factor LR_FACTOR
                           Scale factor applied to the Noam learning rate. (type:
                           float, default: 1)
     --trainer.lrsched.update-lr-on-opt-step, --no_trainer.lrsched.update-lr-on-opt-step
                           Update lr per optimizer step instead of per epoch.
                           (type: bool, default: True)

     --trainer.wdsched.wdsch-type {none,cos_wd}
                           Weight decay scheduler type: none (no schedule) or
                           cos_wd (cosine annealing). (type: <method 'lower' of
                           'str' objects>, default: none)
     --trainer.wdsched.initial-wd INITIAL_WD
                           Initial weight decay value; it should be lower than
                           the final value defined in the optimizer param groups.
                           (type: float, default: 1e-05)
     --trainer.wdsched.warmup-steps WARMUP_STEPS
                           Number of warmup steps to reach the final weight decay
                           value. (type: int, default: 0)
     --trainer.wdsched.update-wd-on-opt-step, --no_trainer.wdsched.update-wd-on-opt-step
                           Update weight decay every optimizer step instead of
                           once per epoch. (type: bool, default: True)

hyperion-apply-mvn-select-frames
--------------------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.apply_mvn_select_frames``.
Support level: **stable**.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: apply_mvn_select_frames.py --input INPUT_SPEC --output OUTPUT_SPEC
                                     [--vad VAD_SPEC]
                                     [--write-num-frames WRITE_NUM_FRAMES_SPEC]
                                     [--path-prefix PATH_PREFIX]
                                     [--vad-path-prefix VAD_PATH_PREFIX]
                                     [--part-idx PART_IDX]
                                     [--num-parts NUM_PARTS] [--compress]
                                     [--compression-method {auto,speech-feat,2byte-auto,2byte-signed-integer,1byte-auto,1byte-unsigned-integer,1byte-0-1,speech-feat-t}]
                                     [--no-norm-mean] [--norm-var]
                                     [--left-context LEFT_CONTEXT]
                                     [--right-context RIGHT_CONTEXT]
                                     [--context CONTEXT]
                                     [--tol-num-frames TOL_NUM_FRAMES]
                                     [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Apply mean-variance normalization and optional VAD-based frame selection

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --input INPUT_SPEC    input feature rspecifier or file path (required)
     --output OUTPUT_SPEC  output feature wspecifier or file path (required)
     --vad VAD_SPEC        optional VAD rspecifier/path used to select speech
                           frames (default: null)
     --write-num-frames WRITE_NUM_FRAMES_SPEC
                           optional output path to write number of selected
                           frames per utterance (default: null)
     --path-prefix PATH_PREFIX
                           optional prefix prepended to file paths in input scp
                           entries (default: null)
     --vad-path-prefix VAD_PATH_PREFIX
                           optional prefix prepended to file paths in VAD scp
                           entries (default: null)
     --part-idx PART_IDX   1-based part index to process when splitting input
                           into --num-parts (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-parts NUM_PARTS
                           total number of parts used to split the input list
                           (type: int, default: 1)
     --compress            apply lossy compression when writing output features
                           (default: False)
     --compression-method {auto,speech-feat,2byte-auto,2byte-signed-integer,1byte-auto,1byte-unsigned-integer,1byte-0-1,speech-feat-t}
                           compression method (used when --compress is set):
                           {auto (default), speech_feat, 2byte-auto, 2byte-
                           signed-integer, 1byte-auto, 1byte-unsigned-integer,
                           1byte-0-1}. (default: auto)
     --no-norm-mean        don't center the features (default: False)
     --norm-var            normalize the variance of the features (default:
                           False)
     --left-context LEFT_CONTEXT
                           past context in number of frames (type: int, default:
                           150)
     --right-context RIGHT_CONTEXT
                           future context in number of frames (type: int,
                           default: 150)
     --context CONTEXT     past/future context in number of frames, overwrites
                           left-context and right-context options (type: int,
                           default: null)
     --tol-num-frames TOL_NUM_FRAMES
                           maximum tolerated error between number of feature
                           frames and VAD frames. (type: int, default: 3)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           verbosity level (0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug)
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

hyperion-audio-to-duration
--------------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.audio_to_duration``.
Support level: **stable**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``audio backend``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: audio_to_duration.py [--cfg CFG] --audio-file AUDIO_FILE --output-file
                               OUTPUT_FILE [--wav-scale WAV_SCALE]
                               [--part-idx PART_IDX] [--num-parts NUM_PARTS]
                               [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Write audio durations to an output table

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             configuration file
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --audio-file AUDIO_FILE
                           input audio rspecifier/path (e.g., wav.scp or audio
                           archive) (required)
     --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                           output table path with one duration entry per
                           utterance (required)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --part-idx PART_IDX   splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-parts NUM_PARTS
                           splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           verbosity level (0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug)
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

hyperion-cluster-embeddings
---------------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.cluster_embeddings``.
Support level: **stable**.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: cluster_embeddings.py [--cfg CFG]
                                {cos_ahc,spectral_clustering,cos_ahc_plda_ahc}
                                ...

   Cluster embeddings into classes, usually speakers

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             configuration file
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.

   subcommands:
     For more details of each subcommand, add it as an argument followed by
     --help.

     Available subcommands:
                           (required)
       cos_ahc
       spectral_clustering
       cos_ahc_plda_ahc

hyperion-cluster-embeddings cos_ahc
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

.. code-block:: text

   usage: cluster_embeddings.py [options] cos_ahc [--cfg CFG] --feats-file
                                                  FEATS_FILE --segments-file
                                                  SEGMENTS_FILE --output-file
                                                  OUTPUT_FILE
                                                  [--filter-by-gmm-post FILTER_BY_GMM_POST]
                                                  [-v {0,1,2,3}] [--lnorm]
                                                  [--pca CONFIG]
                                                  [--pca.update-mu]
                                                  [--pca.update-T] [--pca.whiten]
                                                  [--pca.pca-dim PCA_DIM]
                                                  [--pca.pca-var-r PCA_VAR_R]
                                                  [--pca.pca-min-dim PCA_MIN_DIM]
                                                  [--pca.name NAME]
                                                  [--linkage-method {single,complete,average,weighted,ward}]
                                                  [--stop-criterion {threshold,num_clusters}]
                                                  [--num-clusters NUM_CLUSTERS]
                                                  [--threshold THRESHOLD]
                                                  [--ahc-precision {half,single,double}]
                                                  [--pre_kmeans.samples-per-cluster SAMPLES_PER_CLUSTER]
                                                  [--pre_kmeans.init_method {KMeansInitMethod.max_dist,KMeansInitMethod.random}]
                                                  [--pre_kmeans.epochs EPOCHS]
                                                  [--pre_kmeans.rtol RTOL]
                                                  [--num-workers NUM_WORKERS]

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             configuration file
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --feats-file FEATS_FILE
                           input embedding rspecifier/path (required)
     --segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE
                           input SegmentSet file containing embedding ids
                           (required)
     --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                           output SegmentSet file with assigned cluster ids
                           (required)
     --filter-by-gmm-post FILTER_BY_GMM_POST
                           remove segments with gmm posterior lower than
                           threshold (type: float, default: 0)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           verbosity level (0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug)
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)
     --lnorm, --no_lnorm   apply length normalization (type: bool, default:
                           False)
     --pca CONFIG          Path to a configuration file.
     --linkage-method {single,complete,average,weighted,ward}
                           linkage method (default: average)
     --stop-criterion {threshold,num_clusters}
                           stopping criterion (default: threshold)
     --num-clusters NUM_CLUSTERS
                           number of AHC clusters (type: int, default: null)
     --threshold THRESHOLD
                           AHC stopping threshold when --stop-criterion=threshold
                           (type: float, default: 0)
     --ahc-precision {half,single,double}
                           precision used to compute the AHC score matrix
                           (default: single)
     --pre_kmeans.samples-per-cluster SAMPLES_PER_CLUSTER
                           run pre-kmeans with roughly this many samples per
                           cluster (type: int, default: 1)
     --pre_kmeans.init_method {KMeansInitMethod.max_dist,KMeansInitMethod.random}
                           initialization method for pre-kmeans (default:
                           KMeansInitMethod.max_dist)
     --pre_kmeans.epochs EPOCHS
                           maximum pre-kmeans epochs (type: int, default: 100)
     --pre_kmeans.rtol RTOL
                           relative convergence tolerance for pre-kmeans (type:
                           float, default: 0.001)
     --num-workers NUM_WORKERS
                           number of workers for pre-kmeans (type: int, default:
                           1)

     --pca.update-mu, --no_pca.update-mu
                           updates centering parameter (type: bool, default:
                           True)
     --pca.update-T, --no_pca.update-T
                           updates whitening parameter (type: bool, default:
                           True)
     --pca.whiten, --no_pca.whiten
                           whitens the data after projection (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --pca.pca-dim PCA_DIM
                           output dimension of PCA (type: int, default: null)
     --pca.pca-var-r PCA_VAR_R
                           proportion of variance to keep when choosing the PCA
                           dimension (type: float, default: null)
     --pca.pca-min-dim PCA_MIN_DIM
                           min. output dimension of PCA (type: int, default: 2)
     --pca.name NAME       (default: pca)

                           number of workers for pre-kmeans (type: int, default:
                           1)
     --affinity.aff_func {cos,gauss_cos}
                           affinity function used to build graph edges (default:
                           cos)
     --affinity.gauss-sigma GAUSS_SIGMA
                           std. dev. of gauss function (type: float, default: 1)
     --affinity.aff-thr AFF_THR
                           affinity values below this threshold are set to 0
                           (type: float, default: 0)
     --affinity.precision {half,single,double}
                           precision used to compute the affinity matrix
                           (default: single)
     --spectral_clustering CONFIG
                           Path to a configuration file.

     --pca.update-mu, --no_pca.update-mu
                           updates centering parameter (type: bool, default:
                           True)
     --pca.update-T, --no_pca.update-T
                           updates whitening parameter (type: bool, default:
                           True)
     --pca.whiten, --no_pca.whiten
                           whitens the data after projection (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --pca.pca-dim PCA_DIM
                           output dimension of PCA (type: int, default: null)
     --pca.pca-var-r PCA_VAR_R
                           proportion of variance to keep when choosing the PCA
                           dimension (type: float, default: null)
     --pca.pca-min-dim PCA_MIN_DIM
                           min. output dimension of PCA (type: int, default: 2)
     --pca.name NAME       (default: pca)

     --spectral_clustering.laplacian {LaplacianType.unnormalized,LaplacianType.norm_sym,LaplacianType.norm_rw}
                           graph Laplacian type used to compute spectral
                           embeddings (default: LaplacianType.norm_sym)
     --spectral_clustering.num-clusters NUM_CLUSTERS
                           fixed number of clusters; if omitted, estimate from
                           eigengap (type: int, default: null)
     --spectral_clustering.max-num-clusters MAX_NUM_CLUSTERS
                           maximum number of clusters/eigenvectors considered for
                           automatic selection (type: int, default: null)
     --spectral_clustering.criterion {SpectralClusteringNumClassCriterion.max_eigengap,SpectralClusteringNumClassCriterion.max_d_eig_vals,SpectralClusteringNumClassCriterion.thr_eigengap,SpectralClusteringNumClassCriterion.thr_d_eig_vals}
                           criterion used to estimate number of clusters when
                           --num-clusters is not set (default:
                           SpectralClusteringNumClassCriterion.max_eigengap)
     --spectral_clustering.thr-eigengap THR_EIGENGAP
                           threshold used by threshold-based cluster-count
                           criteria (type: float, default: 0.001)
     --spectral_clustering.kmeans-epochs KMEANS_EPOCHS
                           maximum number of k-means epochs in spectral embedding
                           space (type: int, default: 100)
     --spectral_clustering.kmeans-init-method {KMeansInitMethod.max_dist,KMeansInitMethod.random}
                           k-means centroid initialization strategy (default:
                           KMeansInitMethod.max_dist)
     --spectral_clustering.num-workers NUM_WORKERS
                           number of worker threads used by k-means (type: int,
                           default: 1)

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.

     --num-clusters-stage-2 NUM_CLUSTERS_STAGE_2

     --ahc-precision {half,single,double}

                           single)

     --max-samples-per-cluster MAX_SAMPLES_PER_CLUSTER

     --plda CONFIG         Path to a configuration file.
     --pre_kmeans.samples-per-cluster SAMPLES_PER_CLUSTER
                           run pre-kmeans with roughly this many samples per
                           cluster (type: int, default: 1)
     --pre_kmeans.init_method {KMeansInitMethod.max_dist,KMeansInitMethod.random}
                           initialization method for pre-kmeans (default:
                           KMeansInitMethod.max_dist)
     --pre_kmeans.epochs EPOCHS
                           maximum pre-kmeans epochs (type: int, default: 100)
     --pre_kmeans.rtol RTOL
                           relative convergence tolerance for pre-kmeans (type:
                           float, default: 0.001)
     --num-workers NUM_WORKERS
                           number of workers for pre-kmeans (type: int, default:
                           1)

     --pca.update-mu, --no_pca.update-mu
                           updates centering parameter (type: bool, default:
                           True)
     --pca.update-T, --no_pca.update-T

                           True)
     --pca.whiten, --no_pca.whiten

                           default: False)
     --pca.pca-dim PCA_DIM
                           output dimension of PCA (type: int, default: null)
     --pca.pca-var-r PCA_VAR_R
                           proportion of variance to keep when choosing the PCA

     --pca.pca-min-dim PCA_MIN_DIM
                           min. output dimension of PCA (type: int, default: 2)
     --pca.name NAME       (default: pca)

     --plda.plda-type {PLDAType.FRPLDA,PLDAType.SPLDA,PLDAType.PLDA}
                           Selects the backend variant (full-rank, simplified, or
                           full PLDA). (default: PLDAType.SPLDA)
     --plda.y-dim Y_DIM    Latent speaker-factor dimensionality (number of
                           eigenvoices). (type: int, default: 150)
     --plda.z-dim Z_DIM    Latent channel-factor dimensionality (number of
                           eigenchannels). (type: int, default: 400)
     --plda.fullcov-W, --no_plda.fullcov-W
                           Use a full covariance matrix for W instead of a
                           diagonal floor. (type: bool, default: True)
     --plda.update-mu, --no_plda.update-mu
                           Enable EM updates of the global mean vector. (type:
                           bool, default: True)
     --plda.update-V, --no_plda.update-V
                           Enable updates of the speaker loading matrix V. (type:
                           bool, default: True)
     --plda.update-U, --no_plda.update-U
                           Enable updates of the channel loading matrix U (PLDA
                           only). (type: bool, default: True)
     --plda.update-B, --no_plda.update-B
                           Enable updates of the between-class precision B
                           (FRPLDA). (type: bool, default: True)
     --plda.update-W, --no_plda.update-W
                           Enable updates of the within-class precision W. (type:
                           bool, default: True)
     --plda.update-D, --no_plda.update-D
                           Enable updates of the diagonal noise precision D
                           (PLDA). (type: bool, default: True)
     --plda.floor-iD FLOOR_ID
                           Minimum allowable value for the inverse of each D
                           entry. (type: float, default: 1e-05)
     --plda.prior PRIOR    Prior PLDA model file for Bayesian adaptation.
                           (default: null)
     --plda.r-mu R_MU      Relevance factor for adapting mu in Bayesian training.
                           (type: float, default: 24.0)
     --plda.r-V R_V        Relevance factor for adapting V in Bayesian training.
                           (type: float, default: 128.0)
     --plda.r-B R_B        Relevance factor for adapting B in Bayesian training.
                           (type: float, default: 256.0)
     --plda.r-W R_W        Relevance factor for adapting W in Bayesian training
                           (defaults to 256 for FRPLDA/SPLDA, 128 for PLDA).
                           (type: float, default: null)
     --plda.epochs EPOCHS  Number of EM epochs used during training/adaptation.

     --plda.ml-md {ml+md,ml,md}

hyperion-compute-energy-vad
---------------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.compute_energy_vad``.
Support level: **stable**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``audio backend``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: compute_energy_vad.py [--cfg CFG] [--dataset-file DATASET_FILE]
                                [--recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE]
                                [--segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE] --output-spec
                                OUTPUT_SPEC [--write-num-frames WRITE_NUM_FRAMES]
                                [--write-stats WRITE_STATS] [--remove-cross-talk]
                                [--min-post-cross-talk-dur MIN_POST_CROSS_TALK_DUR]
                                [--vad-plot-dir VAD_PLOT_DIR]
                                [--wav-scale WAV_SCALE] [--part-idx PART_IDX]
                                [--num-parts NUM_PARTS]
                                [--sample-frequency SAMPLE_FREQUENCY]
                                [--frame-length FRAME_LENGTH]
                                [--frame-shift FRAME_SHIFT] [--dither DITHER]
                                [--snip-edges SNIP_EDGES]
                                [--vad-energy-mean-scale VAD_ENERGY_MEAN_SCALE]
                                [--vad-energy-threshold VAD_ENERGY_THRESHOLD]
                                [--vad-frames-context VAD_FRAMES_CONTEXT]
                                [--vad-proportion-threshold VAD_PROPORTION_THRESHOLD]
                                [--vad-energy-floor-threshold VAD_ENERGY_FLOOR_THRESHOLD]
                                [--vad-erosion VAD_EROSION]
                                [--vad-dilation VAD_DILATION] [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Compute Kaldi Energy VAD

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             configuration file
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --dataset-file DATASET_FILE
                           dataset descriptor used by SequentialAudioReader
                           (default: null)
     --recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE
                           optional recordings metadata file for segmented audio
                           reading (default: null)
     --segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE
                           optional segments metadata file for utterance
                           extraction (default: null)
     --output-spec OUTPUT_SPEC
                           output VAD wspecifier/path (required)
     --write-num-frames WRITE_NUM_FRAMES
                           optional output file to write number of VAD frames per
                           utterance (default: null)
     --write-stats WRITE_STATS
                           deprecated/unused compatibility option (default: null)
     --remove-cross-talk, --no_remove-cross-talk
                           remove likely cross-talk frames using non-target
                           channel energy (type: bool, default: False)
     --min-post-cross-talk-dur MIN_POST_CROSS_TALK_DUR
                           minimum speech duration (seconds) after cross-talk
                           removal; otherwise original VAD is kept (type: float,
                           default: 10.0)
     --vad-plot-dir VAD_PLOT_DIR
                           directory to save per-utterance VAD debug plots (type:
                           str, default: null)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --part-idx PART_IDX   splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-parts NUM_PARTS
                           splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --sample-frequency SAMPLE_FREQUENCY
                           Waveform data sample frequency (must match the
                           waveform file, if specified there) (type: int,
                           default: 16000)
     --frame-length FRAME_LENGTH
                           Frame length in milliseconds (type: int, default: 25)
     --frame-shift FRAME_SHIFT
                           Frame shift in milliseconds (type: int, default: 10)
     --dither DITHER       Dithering constant (0.0 means no dither) (type: float,
                           default: 3.0517578125e-05)
     --snip-edges SNIP_EDGES
                           If true, end effects will be handled by outputting
                           only frames that completely fit in the file, and the
                           number of frames depends on the frame-length. If
                           false, the number of frames depends only on the frame-
                           shift, and we reflect the data at the ends. (type:
                           <function str2bool at <address>>, default: True)
     --vad-energy-mean-scale VAD_ENERGY_MEAN_SCALE
                           If this is set to s, to get the actual threshold we
                           let m be the mean log-energy of the file, and use s*m
                           + vad-energy-threshold (type: float, default: 0.5)
     --vad-energy-threshold VAD_ENERGY_THRESHOLD
                           Constant term in energy threshold for MFCC0 for VAD
                           (type: float, default: 5)
     --vad-frames-context VAD_FRAMES_CONTEXT
                           Number of frames of context on each side of central
                           frame, in window for which energy is monitored (type:
                           int, default: 0)
     --vad-proportion-threshold VAD_PROPORTION_THRESHOLD
                           Parameter controlling the proportion of frames within
                           the window that need to have more energy than the
                           threshold (type: float, default: 0.6)
     --vad-energy-floor-threshold VAD_ENERGY_FLOOR_THRESHOLD
                           min energy to be considered in the avg measured from
                           the maximum energy of the signal (type: float,
                           default: 12.5)
     --vad-erosion VAD_EROSION
                           After dilation, it erodes the vad signal by this
                           number of seconds. (type: float, default: 0.0)
     --vad-dilation VAD_DILATION
                           Dilates the vad signal by this number of seconds.
                           (type: float, default: 0.0)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           verbosity level (0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug)
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

.. code-block:: text

   usage: compute_mfcc_feats.py [--cfg CFG] --input INPUT_PATH --output
                                OUTPUT_PATH [--write-num-frames WRITE_NUM_FRAMES]
                                [--wav-scale WAV_SCALE] [--part-idx PART_IDX]

                                [--remove-dc-offset REMOVE_DC_OFFSET]
                                [--preemphasis-coeff PREEMPHASIS_COEFF]
                                [--window-type {hamming,hanning,povey,rectangular,blackman}]
                                [--use-fft2 USE_FFT2] [--dither DITHER]
                                [--fb-type {mel_kaldi,mel_etsi,mel_librosa,mel_librosa_htk,linear}]
                                [--num-filters NUM_FILTERS] [--low-freq LOW_FREQ]
                                [--high-freq HIGH_FREQ] [--norm-filters]
                                [--num-ceps NUM_CEPS] [--snip-edges SNIP_EDGES]
                                [--energy-floor ENERGY_FLOOR]
                                [--raw-energy RAW_ENERGY]
                                [--use-energy USE_ENERGY]
                                [--cepstral-lifter CEPSTRAL_LIFTER]
                                [--input-step {wave,fft,spec,log_spec,logfb}]
                                [--output-step {fft,spec,log_spec,logfb,mfcc}]
                                [--compress]
                                [--compression-method {auto,speech-feat,2byte-auto,2byte-signed-integer,1byte-auto,1byte-unsigned-integer,1byte-0-1,speech-feat-t}]
                                [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Compute MFCC features

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             configuration file
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --input INPUT_PATH    input recordings rspecifier/path (required)
     --output OUTPUT_PATH  output MFCC wspecifier/path (required)
     --write-num-frames WRITE_NUM_FRAMES
                           optional output file to write number of frames per
                           utterance (default: null)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --part-idx PART_IDX   splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-parts NUM_PARTS
                           splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --path-prefix PATH_PREFIX
                           scp file_path prefix (default: null)
     --sample-frequency SAMPLE_FREQUENCY
                           Waveform data sample frequency (must match the
                           waveform file, if specified there) (type: int,
                           default: 16000)
     --frame-length FRAME_LENGTH
                           Frame length in milliseconds (type: int, default: 25)
     --frame-shift FRAME_SHIFT
                           Frame shift in milliseconds (type: int, default: 10)
     --fft-length FFT_LENGTH
                           Length of FFT (type: int, default: 512)
     --remove-dc-offset REMOVE_DC_OFFSET
                           Subtract mean from waveform on each frame (type:
                           <function str2bool at <address>>, default: True)
     --preemphasis-coeff PREEMPHASIS_COEFF
                           Coefficient for use in signal preemphasis (type:
                           float, default: 0.97)
     --window-type {hamming,hanning,povey,rectangular,blackman}
                           Type of window
                           ("hamming"|"hanning"|"povey"|"rectangular"|"blackman")
                           (default: povey)
     --use-fft2 USE_FFT2   If true, it uses |X(f)|^2, if false, it uses |X(f)|
                           (type: <function str2bool at <address>>, default:
                           True)
     --dither DITHER       Dithering constant (0.0 means no dither) (type: float,
                           default: 3.0517578125e-05)
     --fb-type {mel_kaldi,mel_etsi,mel_librosa,mel_librosa_htk,linear}
                           Filter-bank type: mel_kaldi, mel_etsi, mel_librosa,
                           mel_librosa_htk, linear (default: mel_kaldi)
     --num-filters NUM_FILTERS
                           Number of triangular mel-frequency bins (type: int,
                           default: 23)
     --low-freq LOW_FREQ   Low cutoff frequency for mel bins (type: float,
                           default: 20)
     --high-freq HIGH_FREQ
                           High cutoff frequency for mel bins (if < 0, offset
                           from Nyquist) (type: float, default: 0)
     --norm-filters        Normalize filters coeff to sum up to 1 (default:
                           False)
     --num-ceps NUM_CEPS   Number of cepstra in MFCC computation (including C0)
                           (type: int, default: 13)
     --snip-edges SNIP_EDGES
                           If true, end effects will be handled by outputting
                           only frames that completely fit in the file, and the
                           number of frames depends on the frame-length. If
                           false, the number of frames depends only on the frame-
                           shift, and we reflect the data at the ends. (type:
                           <function str2bool at <address>>, default: True)
     --energy-floor ENERGY_FLOOR
                           Floor on energy (absolute, not relative) in MFCC
                           computation (type: float, default: 0)
     --raw-energy RAW_ENERGY
                           If true, compute energy before preemphasis and
                           windowing (type: <function str2bool at <address>>,
                           default: True)
     --use-energy USE_ENERGY
                           Use energy (not C0) in MFCC computation (type:
                           <function str2bool at <address>>, default: True)
     --cepstral-lifter CEPSTRAL_LIFTER
                           Constant that controls scaling of MFCCs (type: float,
                           default: 22)
     --input-step {wave,fft,spec,log_spec,logfb}
                           It can continue computation from any step: wav, fft,
                           spec, logfb (default: wave)
     --output-step {fft,spec,log_spec,logfb,mfcc}
                           It can return intermediate result: fft, spec,
                           log_spec, logfb, mfcc (default: mfcc)
     --compress            compress output features (default: False)
     --compression-method {auto,speech-feat,2byte-auto,2byte-signed-integer,1byte-auto,1byte-unsigned-integer,1byte-0-1,speech-feat-t}
                           compression method (used when --compress is set)
                           (default: auto)

   Eval cosine-scoring with optional AS-Norm

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.

                           --feats-file) (default: null)

                           scoring (default: null)
     --cohort-segments-file COHORT_SEGMENTS_FILE
                           cohort SegmentSet file for AS-Norm (default: null)
     --cohort-feats-file COHORT_FEATS_FILE
                           cohort embedding file for AS-Norm (default: null)
     --cohort-nbest COHORT_NBEST
                           number of closest cohort samples used by adaptive
                           S-Norm (type: int, default: 1000)
     --avg-cohort-by AVG_COHORT_BY
                           cohort SegmentSet column used to average cohort
                           vectors by class (default: null)
     --score-file SCORE_FILE
                           output score file (split suffixes are auto-appended
                           when needed) (required)
     --enroll-part-idx ENROLL_PART_IDX

     --num-enroll-parts NUM_ENROLL_PARTS
                           number of parts in which we divide the enroll list to
                           run evaluation in parallel (type: int, default: 1)
     --test-part-idx TEST_PART_IDX
                           test part index (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-test-parts NUM_TEST_PARTS

                           run evaluation in parallel (type: int, default: 1)

                           optional enrollment embedding file (defaults to
                           --feats-file) (default: null)
     --feats-file FEATS_FILE
                           test embedding file (required)
     --ndx-file NDX_FILE   trial index/key file (required)
     --enroll-map-file ENROLL_MAP_FILE
                           enrollment map relating models to enrollment segments
                           (required)
     --enroll-segments-file ENROLL_SEGMENTS_FILE
                           optional enrollment SegmentSet with quality measures
                           (default: null)
     --segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE
                           optional test SegmentSet with quality measures
                           (default: null)
     --preproc-file PREPROC_FILE
                           optional preprocessing transform list applied before
                           scoring (default: null)
     --qmf-file QMF_FILE   optional logistic-regression model for quality-measure
                           fusion (default: null)
     --quality-measures {snorm-mu/s,snorm-mu,speech_duration,num_speech_frames} [{snorm-mu/s,snorm-mu,speech_duration,num_speech_frames} ...]
                           quality measures to include in output and optional QMF
                           fusion (default: ['snorm-mu/s', 'speech_duration'])
     --min-dur MIN_DUR     lower bound to clip durations (type: float, default:
                           0.1)
     --max-dur MAX_DUR     upper bound to clip durations (type: float, default:
                           30.0)
     --frame-rate FRAME_RATE
                           frames/sec when durations are expressed in frames
                           (type: float, default: 100)
     --cohort-segments-file COHORT_SEGMENTS_FILE
                           cohort SegmentSet file for AS-Norm (default: null)
     --cohort-feats-file COHORT_FEATS_FILE
                           cohort embedding file for AS-Norm (default: null)
     --cohort-nbest COHORT_NBEST
                           number of closest cohort samples used by adaptive
                           S-Norm (type: int, default: 1000)
     --avg-cohort-by AVG_COHORT_BY
                           cohort SegmentSet column used to average cohort
                           vectors by class (default: null)
     --score-file SCORE_FILE
                           output score file (split suffixes are auto-appended
                           when needed) (required)
     --enroll-part-idx ENROLL_PART_IDX
                           enroll part index (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-enroll-parts NUM_ENROLL_PARTS
                           number of parts in which we divide the enroll list to
                           run evaluation in parallel (type: int, default: 1)
     --test-part-idx TEST_PART_IDX
                           test part index (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-test-parts NUM_TEST_PARTS
                           number of parts in which we divide the test list to
                           run evaluation in parallel (type: int, default: 1)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           verbosity level (0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug)
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

                                                     SCORE_ANON_ANON_FILES
                                                     [SCORE_ANON_ANON_FILES ...]
                                                     [--score-ref-anon-files SCORE_REF_ANON_FILES [SCORE_REF_ANON_FILES ...]]
                                                     [--enroll-map-files ENROLL_MAP_FILES [ENROLL_MAP_FILES ...]]
                                                     [--anon-enroll-segments-files ANON_ENROLL_SEGMENTS_FILES [ANON_ENROLL_SEGMENTS_FILES ...]]
                                                     [--anon-test-segments-files ANON_TEST_SEGMENTS_FILES [ANON_TEST_SEGMENTS_FILES ...]]
                                                     --key-names KEY_NAMES
                                                     [KEY_NAMES ...]
                                                     --score-names SCORE_NAMES
                                                     [SCORE_NAMES ...]
                                                     [--p-tar P_TAR [P_TAR ...]]
                                                     [--c-miss C_MISS [C_MISS ...]]
                                                     [--c-fa C_FA [C_FA ...]]
                                                     [--sparse]
                                                     [--class-column CLASS_COLUMN]
                                                     [--anon-class-column ANON_CLASS_COLUMN]
                                                     [--calibrate-on-orig]
                                                     --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                                                     [--output-fig-path OUTPUT_FIG_PATH]
                                                     [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Evaluate speaker verification metrics for anonymization

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Path to a YAML/JSON config file.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --key-files KEY_FILES [KEY_FILES ...]
                           Trial key file(s) containing target/non-target labels.
                           (required)
     --ref-key-file REF_KEY_FILE
                           Trial key file containing target/non-target labels for
                           reference pseudo-speakers vs anonymized. (default:
                           null)
     --score-orig-orig-files SCORE_ORIG_ORIG_FILES [SCORE_ORIG_ORIG_FILES ...]
                           Score file(s) for original enroll vs. original test
                           trials. (required)
     --score-orig-anon-files SCORE_ORIG_ANON_FILES [SCORE_ORIG_ANON_FILES ...]
                           Score file(s) for original enroll vs. anonymized test
                           trials. (required)
     --score-anon-anon-files SCORE_ANON_ANON_FILES [SCORE_ANON_ANON_FILES ...]
                           Score file(s) for anonymized enroll vs. anonymized
                           test trials. (required)
     --score-ref-anon-files SCORE_REF_ANON_FILES [SCORE_REF_ANON_FILES ...]
                           Score file(s) for reference pseudo-speaker vs.
                           anonymized test trials. (default: null)
     --enroll-map-files ENROLL_MAP_FILES [ENROLL_MAP_FILES ...]
                           Optional mapping file(s) between original and
                           anonymized enroll IDs. (default: null)
     --anon-enroll-segments-files ANON_ENROLL_SEGMENTS_FILES [ANON_ENROLL_SEGMENTS_FILES ...]
                           Optional segment table(s) describing anonymized
                           enrollment audio. (default: null)
     --anon-test-segments-files ANON_TEST_SEGMENTS_FILES [ANON_TEST_SEGMENTS_FILES ...]
                           Optional segment table(s) describing anonymized test
                           audio. (default: null)
     --key-names KEY_NAMES [KEY_NAMES ...]
                           Human-readable name(s) for each key file used in
                           reports. (required)
     --score-names SCORE_NAMES [SCORE_NAMES ...]
                           Label(s) identifying each scoring backend/system.
                           (required)
     --p-tar P_TAR [P_TAR ...]
                           target prior(s) used in DCF computation (type: float,
                           default: [0.05, 0.01])
     --c-miss C_MISS [C_MISS ...]
                           miss cost(s) used in DCF computation (type: float,
                           default: null)
     --c-fa C_FA [C_FA ...]
                           false-alarm cost(s) used in DCF computation (type:
                           float, default: null)
     --sparse, --no_sparse
                           Whether to treat the keys as sparse when loading them.
                           (type: bool, default: False)
     --class-column CLASS_COLUMN
                           Column name with original speaker identifiers in the
                           metadata. (default: speaker)
     --anon-class-column ANON_CLASS_COLUMN
                           Column name with anonymized speaker identifiers, if
                           provided. (default: pseudo_speaker)
     --calibrate-on-orig, --no_calibrate-on-orig
                           Fit a calibration model on original-original scores
                           before scoring. (type: bool, default: False)
     --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                           Destination CSV/TSV file where aggregated metrics are
                           written. (required)
     --output-fig-path OUTPUT_FIG_PATH
                           Directory to store optional privacy and consistency
                           histograms. (default: null)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level: 0=warning, 1=info, 2=debug, 3=trace.
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

.. code-block:: text

   usage: eval_wav2vec2xvector_logits.py [--cfg CFG]
                                         [--dataset-path DATASET_PATH]
                                         [--recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE]

                                         [--wav-scale WAV_SCALE]
                                         [--part-idx PART_IDX]
                                         [--num-parts NUM_PARTS]
                                         [--aug-cfg AUG_CFG]
                                         [--aug-info-path AUG_INFO_PATH]
                                         [--num-augs NUM_AUGS] --model-path
                                         MODEL_PATH [--chunk-length CHUNK_LENGTH]
                                         [--random-utt-length]
                                         [--min-utt-length MIN_UTT_LENGTH]
                                         [--max-utt-length MAX_UTT_LENGTH]
                                         [--logits-path LOGITS_PATH]
                                         [--output-spec OUTPUT_SPEC] [--use-gpu]
                                         [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Extracts x-vectors from waveform computing acoustic features on the fly

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Path to a configuration file.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --dataset-path DATASET_PATH
                           HyperDataset manifest describing
                           recordings/segments/VAD tables (default: null)
     --recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE
                           Recording specifier used when not reading from a
                           dataset (default: null)
     --segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE
                           Kaldi segments specifier (only valid when using
                           --recordings-file) (default: null)
     --vad VAD_SPEC        (Deprecated) VAD specifier kept for backward
                           compatibility (default: null)
     --vad-file VAD_FILE   Standalone VAD specifier that overrides --vad when
                           provided (default: null)
     --vad-name VAD_NAME   Name of the dataset VAD entry to use (default: null)
     --write-speech-dur WRITE_SPEECH_DUR
                           Path to write utt2dur-style speech duration
                           information (default: null)
     --vad-path-prefix VAD_PATH_PREFIX
                           scp file_path prefix for vad (default: null)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --part-idx PART_IDX   splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-parts NUM_PARTS
                           splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --aug-cfg AUG_CFG     JSON/CFG file describing online augmentation recipes
                           (default: null)
     --aug-info-path AUG_INFO_PATH
                           Optional CSV file storing augmentation metadata
                           (default: null)
     --num-augs NUM_AUGS   number of augmentations per utterance (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --model-path MODEL_PATH
                           Path to the wav2vec2-xvector model file (required)
     --chunk-length CHUNK_LENGTH

                           (default: False)

                           Number of triangular mel-frequency bins (type: int,

                           default: 20)
     --feats.audio_feats.high-freq HIGH_FREQ
                           High cutoff frequency for mel bins (if < 0, offset
                           from Nyquist) (type: float, default: 0)
     --feats.audio_feats.norm-filters
                           Normalize filters coeff to sum up to 1 (default:

     --feats.audio_feats.num-ceps NUM_CEPS
                           Number of cepstra in MFCC computation (including C0)
                           (type: int, default: 13)
     --feats.audio_feats.snip-edges, --no_feats.audio_feats.snip-edges
                           If true, end effects will be handled by outputting

                           false, the number of frames depends only on the frame-
                           shift, and we reflect the data at the ends. (type:
                           bool, default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.center, --no_feats.audio_feats.center
                           If true, puts the center of the frame at

     --feats.audio_feats.energy-floor ENERGY_FLOOR
                           Floor on energy (absolute, not relative) in MFCC

     --feats.audio_feats.raw-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.raw-energy

     --feats.audio_feats.use-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.use-energy
                           Use energy (not C0) in MFCC computation (type: bool,
                           default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.cepstral-lifter CEPSTRAL_LIFTER

     --feats.audio_feats.audio-feat {fft,spec,log_spec,logfb,mfcc,kanbayashi_logfb}
                           It can return intermediate result: fft, spec,
                           log_spec, logfb, mfcc (default: logfb)

     --feats.mvn.norm-mean, --no_feats.mvn.norm-mean
                           center the features (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.mvn.norm-var, --no_feats.mvn.norm-var
                           normalize the variance of the features (type: bool,

     --feats.mvn.left-context LEFT_CONTEXT

     --feats.mvn.right-context RIGHT_CONTEXT
                           future context in number of frames (type: int,
                           default: 150)
     --feats.mvn.context CONTEXT
                           past/future context in number of frames, overwrites
                           left-context and right-context options (type: int,
                           default: null)

     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-prob TIME_WARP_PROB
                           Probability of applying time warping. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-window TIME_WARP_WINDOW
                           Time-warp window size (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 5)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-mode {bilinear,linear,nearest,bicubic,trilinear}
                           Interpolation mode used for time warping. (default:
                           bicubic)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-prob TIME_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying time masking. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-width TIME_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-width TIME_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 100)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-num-masks TIME_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-num-masks TIME_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage, --no_feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage
                           If true, min/max time-mask counts are interpreted as
                           percentages per 100 frames. (type: bool, default:
                           False)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-prob FREQ_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying frequency masking. (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-width FREQ_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-width FREQ_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 20)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-method {constant,min,mean}
                           How to choose mask fill value: "constant", "min", or

     --feats.spec_augment.mask-value MASK_VALUE
                           Fill value used when "--mask-method=constant". (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)

     --attack.attack-type {fgsm,snr-fgsm,rand-fgsm,iter-fgsm,cw-l0,cw-l2,cw-linf,pgd}
                           Attack type (type: <method 'lower' of 'str' objects>,
                           default: fgsm)
     --attack.norm {inf,1,2}
                           Attack perturbation norm (default: inf)
     --attack.eps EPS      attack epsilon, upper bound for the perturbation norm
                           (type: float, default: 0.1)
     --attack.snr SNR      upper bound for the signal-to-noise ratio of the
                           perturved signal (type: float, default: 100)
     --attack.alpha ALPHA  alpha for iter and rand fgsm attack (type: float,
                           default: 0.01)
     --attack.random-eps   use random epsilon in PGD attack (default: False)
     --attack.confidence CONFIDENCE
                           confidence for carlini-wagner attack (type: float,
                           default: 0)
     --attack.lr LR        learning rate for attack optimizers (type: float,
                           default: 0.01)
     --attack.binary-search-steps BINARY_SEARCH_STEPS

                           (type: int, default: 9)
     --attack.max-iter MAX_ITER
                           max. num. of optim iters in attack (type: int,
                           default: 10)

                           initial weight of constraint function f in carlini-
                           wagner attack (type: float, default: 0.01)
     --attack.reduce-c     allow to reduce c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (default: False)
     --attack.c-incr-factor C_INCR_FACTOR
                           factor to increment c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (type: float, default: 2)

                           factor to reduce tau in carline-wagner-linf attack
                           (type: float, default: 0.75)
     --attack.indep-channels
                           consider independent input channels in carline-
                           wagner-l0 attack (default: False)
     --attack.no-abort     do not abort early in optimizer iterations (default:
                           False)
     --attack.num-random-init NUM_RANDOM_INIT
                           number of random initializations in PGD attack (type:
                           int, default: 0)
     --attack.targeted     use targeted attack intead of non-targeted (default:
                           False)
     --attack.use-snr      In carlini-wagner attack maximize SNR instead of
                           minimize perturbation norm (default: False)
     --attack.norm-time    normalize norm by number of samples in time dimension
                           (default: False)

     --save-adv-wav-path SAVE_ADV_WAV_PATH

                           (default: null)

                           null)

                           normalized waveform (type: float, default: 0)

                           Path to a configuration file.

                           Apply SpecAugment after short-term mean/variance
                           normalization (default: before MVN). (type: bool,
                           default: False)

                           Frame length in milliseconds (type: float, default:

     --feats.audio_feats.frame-shift FRAME_SHIFT
                           Frame shift in milliseconds (type: float, default:
                           10.0)
     --feats.audio_feats.fft-length FFT_LENGTH
                           Length of FFT (type: int, default: 512)

                           Subtract mean from waveform on each frame (type: bool,
                           default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.preemphasis-coeff PREEMPHASIS_COEFF
                           Coefficient for use in signal preemphasis (type:
                           float, default: 0.97)

                           Type of window
                           ("hamming"|"hanning"|"povey"|"rectangular"|"blackman")
                           (default: povey)
     --feats.audio_feats.use-fft-mag
                           If true, it uses |X(f)|, if false, it uses |X(f)|^2
                           (default: False)
     --feats.audio_feats.dither DITHER
                           Dithering constant (0.0 means no dither) (type: float,
                           default: 3.0517578125e-05)
     --feats.audio_feats.fb-type {mel_kaldi,mel_etsi,mel_librosa,mel_librosa_htk,linear}
                           Filter-bank type: mel_kaldi, mel_etsi, mel_librosa,
                           mel_librosa_htk, linear (default: mel_kaldi)
     --feats.audio_feats.num-filters NUM_FILTERS
                           Number of triangular mel-frequency bins (type: int,
                           default: 23)
     --feats.audio_feats.low-freq LOW_FREQ
                           Low cutoff frequency for mel bins (type: float,
                           default: 20)
     --feats.audio_feats.high-freq HIGH_FREQ
                           High cutoff frequency for mel bins (if < 0, offset
                           from Nyquist) (type: float, default: 0)
     --feats.audio_feats.norm-filters
                           Normalize filters coeff to sum up to 1 (default:
                           False)
     --feats.audio_feats.num-ceps NUM_CEPS
                           Number of cepstra in MFCC computation (including C0)
                           (type: int, default: 13)
     --feats.audio_feats.snip-edges, --no_feats.audio_feats.snip-edges
                           If true, end effects will be handled by outputting
                           only frames that completely fit in the file, and the
                           number of frames depends on the frame-length. If
                           false, the number of frames depends only on the frame-
                           shift, and we reflect the data at the ends. (type:
                           bool, default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.center, --no_feats.audio_feats.center
                           If true, puts the center of the frame at
                           t*frame_shift, it overrides snip-edges and sets it to
                           false (type: bool, default: False)
     --feats.audio_feats.energy-floor ENERGY_FLOOR
                           Floor on energy (absolute, not relative) in MFCC
                           computation (type: float, default: 0)
     --feats.audio_feats.raw-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.raw-energy
                           If true, compute energy before preemphasis and
                           windowing (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.use-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.use-energy
                           Use energy (not C0) in MFCC computation (type: bool,
                           default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.cepstral-lifter CEPSTRAL_LIFTER
                           Constant that controls scaling of MFCCs (type: float,
                           default: 22)
     --feats.audio_feats.audio-feat {fft,spec,log_spec,logfb,mfcc,kanbayashi_logfb}
                           It can return intermediate result: fft, spec,
                           log_spec, logfb, mfcc (default: logfb)

     --feats.mvn.norm-mean, --no_feats.mvn.norm-mean
                           center the features (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.mvn.norm-var, --no_feats.mvn.norm-var
                           normalize the variance of the features (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --feats.mvn.left-context LEFT_CONTEXT
                           past context in number of frames (type: int, default:
                           150)
     --feats.mvn.right-context RIGHT_CONTEXT
                           future context in number of frames (type: int,
                           default: 150)
     --feats.mvn.context CONTEXT
                           past/future context in number of frames, overwrites
                           left-context and right-context options (type: int,
                           default: null)

     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-prob TIME_WARP_PROB
                           Probability of applying time warping. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-window TIME_WARP_WINDOW
                           Time-warp window size (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 5)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-mode {bilinear,linear,nearest,bicubic,trilinear}
                           Interpolation mode used for time warping. (default:
                           bicubic)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-prob TIME_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying time masking. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-width TIME_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-width TIME_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 100)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-num-masks TIME_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-num-masks TIME_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage, --no_feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage
                           If true, min/max time-mask counts are interpreted as
                           percentages per 100 frames. (type: bool, default:
                           False)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-prob FREQ_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying frequency masking. (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-width FREQ_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-width FREQ_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 20)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-method {constant,min,mean}
                           How to choose mask fill value: "constant", "min", or
                           "mean". (default: constant)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-value MASK_VALUE
                           Fill value used when "--mask-method=constant". (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)

     --attack.attack-type {fgsm,snr-fgsm,rand-fgsm,iter-fgsm,cw-l0,cw-l2,cw-linf,pgd}
                           Attack type (type: <method 'lower' of 'str' objects>,
                           default: fgsm)
     --attack.norm {inf,1,2}
                           Attack perturbation norm (default: inf)
     --attack.eps EPS      attack epsilon, upper bound for the perturbation norm
                           (type: float, default: 0.1)
     --attack.snr SNR      upper bound for the signal-to-noise ratio of the
                           perturved signal (type: float, default: 100)
     --attack.alpha ALPHA  alpha for iter and rand fgsm attack (type: float,
                           default: 0.01)
     --attack.random-eps   use random epsilon in PGD attack (default: False)
     --attack.confidence CONFIDENCE
                           confidence for carlini-wagner attack (type: float,
                           default: 0)
     --attack.lr LR        learning rate for attack optimizers (type: float,
                           default: 0.01)
     --attack.binary-search-steps BINARY_SEARCH_STEPS
                           num bin. search steps in carlini-wagner-l2 attack
                           (type: int, default: 9)
     --attack.max-iter MAX_ITER
                           max. num. of optim iters in attack (type: int,
                           default: 10)
     --attack.initial-c INITIAL_C
                           initial weight of constraint function f in carlini-
                           wagner attack (type: float, default: 0.01)
     --attack.reduce-c     allow to reduce c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (default: False)
     --attack.c-incr-factor C_INCR_FACTOR
                           factor to increment c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (type: float, default: 2)
     --attack.tau-decr-factor TAU_DECR_FACTOR
                           factor to reduce tau in carline-wagner-linf attack
                           (type: float, default: 0.75)
     --attack.indep-channels
                           consider independent input channels in carline-
                           wagner-l0 attack (default: False)
     --attack.no-abort     do not abort early in optimizer iterations (default:
                           False)
     --attack.num-random-init NUM_RANDOM_INIT
                           number of random initializations in PGD attack (type:
                           int, default: 0)
     --attack.targeted     use targeted attack intead of non-targeted (default:
                           False)
     --attack.use-snr      In carlini-wagner attack maximize SNR instead of
                           minimize perturbation norm (default: False)
     --attack.norm-time    normalize norm by number of samples in time dimension
                           (default: False)

   fly
