                           variance (default: False)
     --trainer.optim.lr-decay LR_DECAY
                           Learning rate decay in AdaGrad optimizer (type: float,
                           default: 1e-06)
     --trainer.optim.init-acc-val INIT_ACC_VAL
                           Init accum value in Adagrad (type: float, default: 0)
     --trainer.optim.max-iter MAX_ITER
                           max iterations in LBFGS (type: int, default: 20)

     --trainer.lrsched.lrsch-type {none,exp_lr,invpow_lr,cos_lr,adamcos_lr,red_lr_on_plateau,noam_lr,triangular_lr}
                           Learning rate scheduler type (e.g., exp_lr, invpow_lr,
                           cos_lr, adamcos_lr, red_lr_on_plateau, noam_lr,
                           triangular_lr). (type: <method 'lower' of 'str'
                           objects>, default: none)
     --trainer.lrsched.decay-rate DECAY_RATE
                           Exponential decay factor applied every decay_steps.
                           (type: float, default: 0.01)
     --trainer.lrsched.decay-steps DECAY_STEPS
                           Number of steps between exponential decays. (type:
                           int, default: 100)
     --trainer.lrsched.power POWER
                           Exponent for inverse power decay (lr ~ step^-power).
                           (type: float, default: 0.5)
     --trainer.lrsched.hold-steps HOLD_STEPS
                           Number of steps to hold the initial lr before decay.
                           (type: int, default: 10)
     --trainer.lrsched.t T
                           Cycle length for cosine/triangular schedules (in
                           steps). (type: int, default: 10)
     --trainer.lrsched.t-mul T_MUL
                           Cycle length multiplier after each restart
                           (cos/triangular). (type: int, default: 1)
     --trainer.lrsched.gamma GAMMA
                           Max lr multiplier after each restart (cos/triangular).
                           (type: float, default: 1.0)
     --trainer.lrsched.warm-restarts, --no_trainer.lrsched.warm-restarts
                           Enable warm restarts in cosine schedules. (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --trainer.lrsched.monitor MONITOR
                           Metric name to monitor for ReduceLROnPlateau.
                           (default: val_loss)
     --trainer.lrsched.mode {min,max}
                           Whether lower or higher metric is better for plateau
                           reduction. (default: min)
     --trainer.lrsched.factor FACTOR
                           Multiply lr by this factor when plateau reduction
                           triggers. (type: float, default: 0.1)
     --trainer.lrsched.patience PATIENCE
                           Epochs with no improvement before reducing lr. (type:
                           int, default: 10)
     --trainer.lrsched.threshold THRESHOLD
                           Minimum change to qualify as an improvement. (type:
                           float, default: 0.0001)
     --trainer.lrsched.threshold_mode {rel,abs}
                           Use relative or absolute threshold for improvements.
                           (default: rel)
     --trainer.lrsched.cooldown COOLDOWN
                           Epochs to wait after a reduction before resuming
                           checks. (type: int, default: 0)
     --trainer.lrsched.eps EPS
                           Minimum lr change; smaller updates are ignored. (type:
                           float, default: 1e-08)
     --trainer.lrsched.min-lr MIN_LR
                           Lower bound for learning rate. (type: float, default:
                           0)
     --trainer.lrsched.warmup-steps WARMUP_STEPS
                           Steps to linearly warm up lr from 0 to the base value.
                           (type: int, default: null)
     --trainer.lrsched.d-model D_MODEL
                           Transformer model dimension for Noam schedule. (type:
                           int, default: null)
     --trainer.lrsched.lr-factor LR_FACTOR
                           Scale factor applied to the Noam learning rate. (type:
                           float, default: 1)
     --trainer.lrsched.update-lr-on-opt-step, --no_trainer.lrsched.update-lr-on-opt-step
                           Update lr per optimizer step instead of per epoch.
                           (type: bool, default: True)

     --trainer.wdsched.wdsch-type {none,cos_wd}
                           Weight decay scheduler type: none (no schedule) or
                           cos_wd (cosine annealing). (type: <method 'lower' of
                           'str' objects>, default: none)
     --trainer.wdsched.initial-wd INITIAL_WD
                           Initial weight decay value; it should be lower than
                           the final value defined in the optimizer param groups.
                           (type: float, default: 1e-05)
     --trainer.wdsched.warmup-steps WARMUP_STEPS
                           Number of warmup steps to reach the final weight decay
                           value. (type: int, default: 0)
     --trainer.wdsched.update-wd-on-opt-step, --no_trainer.wdsched.update-wd-on-opt-step
                           Update weight decay every optimizer step instead of
                           once per epoch. (type: bool, default: True)

     --feats.audio_feats.audio-feat {fft,spec,log_spec,logfb,mfcc,kanbayashi_logfb}
                           It can return intermediate result: fft, spec,
                           log_spec, logfb, mfcc (default: logfb)

     --feats.mvn.norm-mean, --no_feats.mvn.norm-mean
                           center the features (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.mvn.norm-var, --no_feats.mvn.norm-var
                           normalize the variance of the features (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --feats.mvn.left-context LEFT_CONTEXT
                           past context in number of frames (type: int, default:
                           150)
     --feats.mvn.right-context RIGHT_CONTEXT
                           future context in number of frames (type: int,
                           default: 150)
     --feats.mvn.context CONTEXT
                           past/future context in number of frames, overwrites
                           left-context and right-context options (type: int,
                           default: null)

     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-prob TIME_WARP_PROB
                           Probability of applying time warping. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-window TIME_WARP_WINDOW
                           Time-warp window size (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 5)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-mode {bilinear,linear,nearest,bicubic,trilinear}
                           Interpolation mode used for time warping. (default:
                           bicubic)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-prob TIME_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying time masking. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-width TIME_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-width TIME_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 100)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-num-masks TIME_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-num-masks TIME_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage, --no_feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage
                           If true, min/max time-mask counts are interpreted as
                           percentages per 100 frames. (type: bool, default:
                           False)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-prob FREQ_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying frequency masking. (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-width FREQ_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-width FREQ_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 20)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-method {constant,min,mean}
                           How to choose mask fill value: "constant", "min", or
                           "mean". (default: constant)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-value MASK_VALUE
                           Fill value used when "--mask-method=constant". (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)

     --attacks.attack-types {fgsm,snr-fgsm,rand-fgsm,iter-fgsm,cw-l0,cw-l2,cw-linf,pgd} [{fgsm,snr-fgsm,rand-fgsm,iter-fgsm,cw-l0,cw-l2,cw-linf,pgd} ...]
                           Attack types (type: <method 'lower' of 'str' objects>,
                           default: ['fgsm'])
     --attacks.norms {inf,1,2} [{inf,1,2} ...]
                           Attack perturbation norms (default: ['inf'])
     --attacks.min-eps MIN_EPS
                           attack min epsilon, upper bound for the perturbation
                           norm (type: float, default: 1e-05)
     --attacks.max-eps MAX_EPS
                           attack max epsilon, upper bound for the perturbation
                           norm (type: float, default: 0.1)
     --attacks.min-snr MIN_SNR
                           min upper bound for the signal-to-noise ratio of the
                           perturbed signal (type: float, default: 30)
     --attacks.max-snr MAX_SNR
                           max upper bound for the signal-to-noise ratio of the
                           perturbed signal (type: float, default: 60)
     --attacks.min-alpha MIN_ALPHA
                           min alpha for iter and rand fgsm attack (type: float,
                           default: 1e-05)
     --attacks.max-alpha MAX_ALPHA
                           max alpha for iter and rand fgsm attack (type: float,
                           default: 0.02)
     --attacks.random-eps  use random epsilon in PGD attack (default: False)
     --attacks.min-confidence MIN_CONFIDENCE
                           min confidence for carlini-wagner attack (type: float,
                           default: 0)
     --attacks.max-confidence MAX_CONFIDENCE
                           max confidence for carlini-wagner attack (type: float,
                           default: 1)
     --attacks.min-lr MIN_LR
                           min learning rate for attack optimizers (type: float,
                           default: 0.001)
     --attacks.max-lr MAX_LR
                           max learning rate for attack optimizers (type: float,
                           default: 0.01)
     --attacks.min-binary-search-steps MIN_BINARY_SEARCH_STEPS
                           min num bin. search steps in carlini-wagner-l2 attack
                           (type: int, default: 9)
     --attacks.max-binary-search-steps MAX_BINARY_SEARCH_STEPS
                           max num bin. search steps in carlini-wagner-l2 attack
                           (type: int, default: 9)
     --attacks.min-iter MIN_ITER
                           min maximum. num. of optim iters in attack (type: int,
                           default: 5)
     --attacks.max-iter MAX_ITER
                           max maximum num. of optim iters in attack (type: int,
                           default: 10)
     --attacks.min-c MIN_C
                           min initial weight of constraint function f in
                           carlini-wagner attack (type: float, default: 0.001)
     --attacks.max-c MAX_C
                           max initial weight of constraint function f in
                           carlini-wagner attack (type: float, default: 0.01)
     --attacks.reduce-c    allow to reduce c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (default: False)
     --attacks.c-incr-factor C_INCR_FACTOR
                           factor to increment c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (type: float, default: 2)
     --attacks.tau-decr-factor TAU_DECR_FACTOR
                           factor to reduce tau in carline-wagner-linf attack
                           (type: float, default: 0.75)
     --attacks.indep-channels
                           consider independent input channels in carlini-
                           wagner-l0 attack (default: False)
     --attacks.no-abort    do not abort early in optimizer iterations (default:
                           False)
     --attacks.min-num-random-init MIN_NUM_RANDOM_INIT
                           min number of random initializations in PGD attack
                           (type: int, default: 1)
     --attacks.max-num-random-init MAX_NUM_RANDOM_INIT
                           max number of random initializations in PGD attack
                           (type: int, default: 5)
     --attacks.targeted    use targeted attack intead of non-targeted (default:
                           False)
     --attacks.use-snr     In carlini-wagner attack maximize SNR instead of
                           minimize perturbation norm (default: False)
     --attacks.norm-time   normalize norm by number of samples in time dimension
                           (default: False)

   Generate Attacks for speaker verification with x-vectors+cos+calibration

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Path to a configuration file.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --v-file V_FILE       Input x-vector rspecifier for enrollment embeddings.
                           (required)
     --key-file KEY_FILE   Trial key file with target/non-target labels.
                           (default: null)
     --enroll-file ENROLL_FILE
                           Enrollment file mapping model ids to x-vector keys.
                           (required)
     --test-wav-file TEST_WAV_FILE
                           Audio recordings specifier for test utterances.
                           (required)
     --attack-tag ATTACK_TAG
                           Tag appended to generated adversarial utterance keys.
                           (required)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --target-sample-freq TARGET_SAMPLE_FREQ
                           resample input audio to target frequency (type: int,
                           default: null)
     --feats CONFIG        Path to a configuration file.
     --vad VAD_SPEC        Optional VAD specifier used to select speech frames.
                           (default: null)
     --vad-path-prefix VAD_PATH_PREFIX
                           Optional path prefix prepended to VAD SCP paths.
                           (default: null)
     --model-path MODEL_PATH
                           Path to x-vector model checkpoint. (required)
     --embed-layer EMBED_LAYER
                           Embedding layer index to extract from; if not set, use
                           the model default from training. (type: int, default:
                           null)
     --use-gpu             Run attack generation on GPU. (default: False)
     --cal-file CAL_FILE   score calibration file (default: null)
     --threshold THRESHOLD
                           decision threshold (type: float, default: 0)
     --attacks CONFIG      Path to a configuration file.
     --seg-part-idx SEG_PART_IDX
                           1-based index of the current test partition. (type:
                           int, default: 1)
     --num-seg-parts NUM_SEG_PARTS
                           number of parts in which we divide the test list to
                           run evaluation in parallel (type: int, default: 1)
     --output-wav-dir OUTPUT_WAV_DIR
                           Directory where adversarial waveforms are written.
                           (default: null)
     --attack-info-file ATTACK_INFO_FILE
                           YAML file where metadata for generated attacks is
                           saved. (default: null)
     --random-seed RANDOM_SEED
                           Base random seed. (type: int, default: 1234)
     --p-tar-attack P_TAR_ATTACK
                           probability of generating an attack for a target trial
                           (type: float, default: 1)
     --p-non-attack P_NON_ATTACK
                           probability of generating an attack for a non-target
                           trial (type: float, default: 1)
     --save-failed         Save failed attacks as well. (default: False)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug.
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

                           Path to a configuration file.
     --feats.mvn CONFIG    Path to a configuration file.

                           Path to a configuration file.

                           Apply SpecAugment after short-term mean/variance

                           default: False)

     --feats.audio_feats.frame-shift FRAME_SHIFT
                           Frame shift in milliseconds (type: float, default:
                           10.0)
     --feats.audio_feats.fft-length FFT_LENGTH
                           Length of FFT (type: int, default: 512)
     --feats.audio_feats.remove-dc-offset, --no_feats.audio_feats.remove-dc-offset

                           default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.preemphasis-coeff PREEMPHASIS_COEFF

     --feats.audio_feats.dither DITHER
                           Dithering constant (0.0 means no dither) (type: float,
                           default: 3.0517578125e-05)
     --feats.audio_feats.fb-type {mel_kaldi,mel_etsi,mel_librosa,mel_librosa_htk,linear}
                           Filter-bank type: mel_kaldi, mel_etsi, mel_librosa,
                           mel_librosa_htk, linear (default: mel_kaldi)
     --feats.audio_feats.num-filters NUM_FILTERS
                           Number of triangular mel-frequency bins (type: int,

     --feats.audio_feats.high-freq HIGH_FREQ
                           High cutoff frequency for mel bins (if < 0, offset
                           from Nyquist) (type: float, default: 0)
     --feats.audio_feats.norm-filters
                           Normalize filters coeff to sum up to 1 (default:

     --feats.audio_feats.num-ceps NUM_CEPS
                           Number of cepstra in MFCC computation (including C0)

     --feats.audio_feats.snip-edges, --no_feats.audio_feats.snip-edges
                           If true, end effects will be handled by outputting
                           only frames that completely fit in the file, and the
                           number of frames depends on the frame-length. If
                           false, the number of frames depends only on the frame-
                           shift, and we reflect the data at the ends. (type:
                           bool, default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.center, --no_feats.audio_feats.center
                           If true, puts the center of the frame at
                           t*frame_shift, it overrides snip-edges and sets it to
                           false (type: bool, default: False)
     --feats.audio_feats.energy-floor ENERGY_FLOOR
                           Floor on energy (absolute, not relative) in MFCC

     --feats.audio_feats.raw-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.raw-energy
                           If true, compute energy before preemphasis and
                           windowing (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.use-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.use-energy
                           Use energy (not C0) in MFCC computation (type: bool,
                           default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.cepstral-lifter CEPSTRAL_LIFTER
                           Constant that controls scaling of MFCCs (type: float,
                           default: 22)
     --feats.audio_feats.audio-feat {fft,spec,log_spec,logfb,mfcc,kanbayashi_logfb}
                           It can return intermediate result: fft, spec,
                           log_spec, logfb, mfcc (default: logfb)

     --feats.mvn.norm-mean, --no_feats.mvn.norm-mean
                           center the features (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.mvn.norm-var, --no_feats.mvn.norm-var
                           normalize the variance of the features (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --feats.mvn.left-context LEFT_CONTEXT
                           past context in number of frames (type: int, default:
                           150)
     --feats.mvn.right-context RIGHT_CONTEXT
                           future context in number of frames (type: int,
                           default: 150)
     --feats.mvn.context CONTEXT
                           past/future context in number of frames, overwrites
                           left-context and right-context options (type: int,
                           default: null)

     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-prob TIME_WARP_PROB
                           Probability of applying time warping. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-window TIME_WARP_WINDOW
                           Time-warp window size (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 5)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-mode {bilinear,linear,nearest,bicubic,trilinear}
                           Interpolation mode used for time warping. (default:
                           bicubic)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-prob TIME_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying time masking. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-width TIME_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-width TIME_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 100)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-num-masks TIME_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-num-masks TIME_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage, --no_feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage
                           If true, min/max time-mask counts are interpreted as
                           percentages per 100 frames. (type: bool, default:
                           False)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-prob FREQ_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying frequency masking. (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-width FREQ_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-width FREQ_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 20)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-method {constant,min,mean}
                           How to choose mask fill value: "constant", "min", or
                           "mean". (default: constant)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-value MASK_VALUE
                           Fill value used when "--mask-method=constant". (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)

     --attacks.attack-types {fgsm,snr-fgsm,rand-fgsm,iter-fgsm,cw-l0,cw-l2,cw-linf,pgd} [{fgsm,snr-fgsm,rand-fgsm,iter-fgsm,cw-l0,cw-l2,cw-linf,pgd} ...]
                           Attack types (type: <method 'lower' of 'str' objects>,
                           default: ['fgsm'])
     --attacks.norms {inf,1,2} [{inf,1,2} ...]
                           Attack perturbation norms (default: ['inf'])
     --attacks.min-eps MIN_EPS
                           attack min epsilon, upper bound for the perturbation
                           norm (type: float, default: 1e-05)
     --attacks.max-eps MAX_EPS
                           attack max epsilon, upper bound for the perturbation
                           norm (type: float, default: 0.1)
     --attacks.min-snr MIN_SNR
                           min upper bound for the signal-to-noise ratio of the
                           perturbed signal (type: float, default: 30)
     --attacks.max-snr MAX_SNR
                           max upper bound for the signal-to-noise ratio of the
                           perturbed signal (type: float, default: 60)
     --attacks.min-alpha MIN_ALPHA
                           min alpha for iter and rand fgsm attack (type: float,
                           default: 1e-05)
     --attacks.max-alpha MAX_ALPHA
                           max alpha for iter and rand fgsm attack (type: float,
                           default: 0.02)
     --attacks.random-eps  use random epsilon in PGD attack (default: False)
     --attacks.min-confidence MIN_CONFIDENCE
                           min confidence for carlini-wagner attack (type: float,
                           default: 0)
     --attacks.max-confidence MAX_CONFIDENCE
                           max confidence for carlini-wagner attack (type: float,
                           default: 1)
     --attacks.min-lr MIN_LR
                           min learning rate for attack optimizers (type: float,
                           default: 0.001)
     --attacks.max-lr MAX_LR
                           max learning rate for attack optimizers (type: float,
                           default: 0.01)
     --attacks.min-binary-search-steps MIN_BINARY_SEARCH_STEPS
                           min num bin. search steps in carlini-wagner-l2 attack
                           (type: int, default: 9)
     --attacks.max-binary-search-steps MAX_BINARY_SEARCH_STEPS
                           max num bin. search steps in carlini-wagner-l2 attack
                           (type: int, default: 9)
     --attacks.min-iter MIN_ITER
                           min maximum. num. of optim iters in attack (type: int,
                           default: 5)
     --attacks.max-iter MAX_ITER
                           max maximum num. of optim iters in attack (type: int,
                           default: 10)
     --attacks.min-c MIN_C
                           min initial weight of constraint function f in
                           carlini-wagner attack (type: float, default: 0.001)
     --attacks.max-c MAX_C
                           max initial weight of constraint function f in
                           carlini-wagner attack (type: float, default: 0.01)
     --attacks.reduce-c    allow to reduce c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (default: False)
     --attacks.c-incr-factor C_INCR_FACTOR
                           factor to increment c in carline-wagner-l0/inf attack
                           (type: float, default: 2)
     --attacks.tau-decr-factor TAU_DECR_FACTOR
                           factor to reduce tau in carline-wagner-linf attack
                           (type: float, default: 0.75)
     --attacks.indep-channels
                           consider independent input channels in carlini-
                           wagner-l0 attack (default: False)
     --attacks.no-abort    do not abort early in optimizer iterations (default:
                           False)
     --attacks.min-num-random-init MIN_NUM_RANDOM_INIT
                           min number of random initializations in PGD attack
                           (type: int, default: 1)
     --attacks.max-num-random-init MAX_NUM_RANDOM_INIT
                           max number of random initializations in PGD attack
                           (type: int, default: 5)
     --attacks.targeted    use targeted attack intead of non-targeted (default:
                           False)
     --attacks.use-snr     In carlini-wagner attack maximize SNR instead of
                           minimize perturbation norm (default: False)
     --attacks.norm-time   normalize norm by number of samples in time dimension
                           (default: False)

hyperion-infer-qvectors
-----------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.infer_qvectors``.
Support level: **experimental**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``PyTorch``, ``Q-vector checkpoint``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: infer_qvectors.py [--cfg CFG] [--dataset-path DATASET_PATH]
                            [--recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE]
                            [--segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE] [--vad-file VAD_FILE]
                            [--vad-name VAD_NAME] [--wav-scale WAV_SCALE]
                            [--part-idx PART_IDX] [--num-parts NUM_PARTS]
                            [--aug-cfg AUG_CFG] [--aug-info-path AUG_INFO_PATH]
                            [--num-augs NUM_AUGS] --model-path MODEL_PATH
                            [--random-utt-length]
                            [--min-utt-length MIN_UTT_LENGTH]
                            [--max-utt-length MAX_UTT_LENGTH]
                            [--qvector-path QVECTOR_PATH]
                            [--qmatrix-path QMATRIX_PATH]
                            [--logits-path LOGITS_PATH]
                            [--max-batch-duration MAX_BATCH_DURATION]
                            [--override-chunk-duration OVERRIDE_CHUNK_DURATION]
                            [--use-gpu] [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Infer q-vectors from audio recordings

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Path to a configuration file.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --dataset-path DATASET_PATH
                           HyperDataset file describing recordings, segments, and
                           optional VAD tables (default: null)
     --recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE
                           Kaldi-style recording specifier (scp/ark) used when no
                           dataset is provided (default: null)
     --segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE
                           Optional Kaldi segments specifier when --recordings-
                           file is used (default: null)
     --vad-file VAD_FILE   Binary/table VAD specifier used when no embedded
                           dataset VAD is selected (default: null)
     --vad-name VAD_NAME   Name of the VAD entry stored within --dataset-path to
                           use during decoding (default: null)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --part-idx PART_IDX   splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-parts NUM_PARTS
                           splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --aug-cfg AUG_CFG     (default: null)
     --aug-info-path AUG_INFO_PATH
                           (default: null)
     --num-augs NUM_AUGS   number of augmentations per utterance (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --model-path MODEL_PATH
                           (required)
     --random-utt-length   calculates q-vector from a random chunk (default:
                           False)
     --min-utt-length MIN_UTT_LENGTH
                           minimum utterance length in secs when using random utt
                           length (type: float, default: 5)
     --max-utt-length MAX_UTT_LENGTH
                           maximum utterance length in secs when using random utt
                           length (type: float, default: 120)
     --qvector-path QVECTOR_PATH
                           output specifier for qvectors (e.g., ark:filepath or
                           h5:filepath) (default: null)
     --qmatrix-path QMATRIX_PATH
                           output specifier for q-matrices per utterance
                           (default: null)
     --logits-path LOGITS_PATH
                           output specifier for logits (requires a classification
                           head) (default: null)
     --max-batch-duration MAX_BATCH_DURATION
                           max total audio duration per inference batch in
                           seconds (type: float, default: null)
     --override-chunk-duration OVERRIDE_CHUNK_DURATION
                           override internal chunk duration (in seconds) used by
                           the q-vector model (type: float, default: null)
     --use-gpu             infer qvectors in gpu (default: False)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

hyperion-make-babble-noise-audio-files
--------------------------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.make_babble_noise_audio_files``.
Support level: **stable**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``audio backend``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: make_babble_noise_audio_files.py [--cfg CFG] --recordings-file
                                           RECORDINGS_FILE --output-path
                                           OUTPUT_PATH --output-recordings-file
                                           OUTPUT_RECORDINGS_FILE
                                           [--write-time-durs WRITE_TIME_DURS]
                                           [--wav-scale WAV_SCALE]
                                           [--target-sample-freq TARGET_SAMPLE_FREQ]
                                           [--audio-format {flac,ogg,wav}]
                                           [--audio-subtype {pcm_16,pcm_24,pcm_32,float,double,vorbis}]
                                           [--min-spks MIN_SPKS]
                                           [--max-spks MAX_SPKS]
                                           [--num-reuses NUM_REUSES]
                                           [--random-seed RANDOM_SEED]
                                           [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Creates babble noise by adding speech files

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Path to a configuration file.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE
                           Input recordings file used as source utterances.
                           (required)
     --output-path OUTPUT_PATH
                           Output directory for generated babble audio files.
                           (required)
     --output-recordings-file OUTPUT_RECORDINGS_FILE
                           Output recordings manifest for generated babble files.
                           (required)
     --write-time-durs WRITE_TIME_DURS
                           Optional output file to store generated utterance
                           durations. (default: null)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --target-sample-freq TARGET_SAMPLE_FREQ
                           resample input audio to target frequency (type: int,
                           default: null)
     --audio-format {flac,ogg,wav}
                           ouput audio format (default: flac)
     --audio-subtype {pcm_16,pcm_24,pcm_32,float,double,vorbis}
                           coding format for audio file (default: null)
     --min-spks MIN_SPKS   Minimum number of source utterances mixed per babble
                           file. (type: int, default: 3)
     --max-spks MAX_SPKS   Maximum number of source utterances mixed per babble
                           file. (type: int, default: 10)
     --num-reuses NUM_REUSES
                           Number of shuffled passes over the input recordings.
                           (type: int, default: 5)
     --random-seed RANDOM_SEED
                           Random seed for reproducible shuffling. (type: int,
                           default: 112358)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug.
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

                              [--feats.spec_augment.mask-method {constant,min,mean}]

                              --output-path OUTPUT_PATH [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Combines the feature extractor config with XVector model to produce a
   Wav2XVector model with integrated feature extraction

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Path to a configuration file.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --feats CONFIG        Path to a configuration file.
     --xvector-path XVECTOR_PATH
                           Path to the input x-vector model checkpoint.
                           (required)
     --output-path OUTPUT_PATH
                           Output path for the generated Wav2XVector model.
                           (required)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug.
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

     --feats.audio_feats CONFIG
                           Path to a configuration file.
     --feats.mvn CONFIG    Path to a configuration file.
     --feats.spec_augment CONFIG
                           Path to a configuration file.
     --feats.aug-after-mvn, --no_feats.aug-after-mvn
                           Apply SpecAugment after short-term mean/variance
                           normalization (default: before MVN). (type: bool,
                           default: False)

     --feats.audio_feats.sample-frequency SAMPLE_FREQUENCY
                           Waveform data sample frequency (must match the
                           waveform file, if specified there) (type: int,
                           default: 16000)
     --feats.audio_feats.frame-length FRAME_LENGTH
                           Frame length in milliseconds (type: float, default:
                           25.0)
     --feats.audio_feats.frame-shift FRAME_SHIFT
                           Frame shift in milliseconds (type: float, default:
                           10.0)
     --feats.audio_feats.fft-length FFT_LENGTH
                           Length of FFT (type: int, default: 512)
     --feats.audio_feats.remove-dc-offset, --no_feats.audio_feats.remove-dc-offset
                           Subtract mean from waveform on each frame (type: bool,
                           default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.preemphasis-coeff PREEMPHASIS_COEFF
                           Coefficient for use in signal preemphasis (type:
                           float, default: 0.97)
     --feats.audio_feats.window-type {hamming,hanning,povey,rectangular,blackman}
                           Type of window
                           ("hamming"|"hanning"|"povey"|"rectangular"|"blackman")
                           (default: povey)
     --feats.audio_feats.use-fft-mag
                           If true, it uses |X(f)|, if false, it uses |X(f)|^2
                           (default: False)
     --feats.audio_feats.dither DITHER
                           Dithering constant (0.0 means no dither) (type: float,
                           default: 3.0517578125e-05)
     --feats.audio_feats.fb-type {mel_kaldi,mel_etsi,mel_librosa,mel_librosa_htk,linear}
                           Filter-bank type: mel_kaldi, mel_etsi, mel_librosa,
                           mel_librosa_htk, linear (default: mel_kaldi)
     --feats.audio_feats.num-filters NUM_FILTERS
                           Number of triangular mel-frequency bins (type: int,
                           default: 23)
     --feats.audio_feats.low-freq LOW_FREQ
                           Low cutoff frequency for mel bins (type: float,
                           default: 20)
     --feats.audio_feats.high-freq HIGH_FREQ
                           High cutoff frequency for mel bins (if < 0, offset
                           from Nyquist) (type: float, default: 0)
     --feats.audio_feats.norm-filters
                           Normalize filters coeff to sum up to 1 (default:
                           False)
     --feats.audio_feats.num-ceps NUM_CEPS
                           Number of cepstra in MFCC computation (including C0)
                           (type: int, default: 13)
     --feats.audio_feats.snip-edges, --no_feats.audio_feats.snip-edges
                           If true, end effects will be handled by outputting
                           only frames that completely fit in the file, and the
                           number of frames depends on the frame-length. If
                           false, the number of frames depends only on the frame-
                           shift, and we reflect the data at the ends. (type:
                           bool, default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.center, --no_feats.audio_feats.center
                           If true, puts the center of the frame at
                           t*frame_shift, it overrides snip-edges and sets it to
                           false (type: bool, default: False)
     --feats.audio_feats.energy-floor ENERGY_FLOOR
                           Floor on energy (absolute, not relative) in MFCC
                           computation (type: float, default: 0)
     --feats.audio_feats.raw-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.raw-energy
                           If true, compute energy before preemphasis and
                           windowing (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.use-energy, --no_feats.audio_feats.use-energy
                           Use energy (not C0) in MFCC computation (type: bool,
                           default: True)
     --feats.audio_feats.cepstral-lifter CEPSTRAL_LIFTER
                           Constant that controls scaling of MFCCs (type: float,
                           default: 22)
     --feats.audio_feats.audio-feat {fft,spec,log_spec,logfb,mfcc,kanbayashi_logfb}
                           It can return intermediate result: fft, spec,
                           log_spec, logfb, mfcc (default: logfb)

     --feats.mvn.norm-mean, --no_feats.mvn.norm-mean
                           center the features (type: bool, default: True)
     --feats.mvn.norm-var, --no_feats.mvn.norm-var
                           normalize the variance of the features (type: bool,
                           default: False)
     --feats.mvn.left-context LEFT_CONTEXT
                           past context in number of frames (type: int, default:
                           150)
     --feats.mvn.right-context RIGHT_CONTEXT
                           future context in number of frames (type: int,
                           default: 150)
     --feats.mvn.context CONTEXT
                           past/future context in number of frames, overwrites
                           left-context and right-context options (type: int,
                           default: null)

     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-prob TIME_WARP_PROB
                           Probability of applying time warping. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-window TIME_WARP_WINDOW
                           Time-warp window size (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 5)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-warp-mode {bilinear,linear,nearest,bicubic,trilinear}
                           Interpolation mode used for time warping. (default:
                           bicubic)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-prob TIME_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying time masking. (type: float,
                           default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-width TIME_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-width TIME_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum time-mask width (in frames). (type: int,
                           default: 100)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-min-num-masks TIME_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-mask-max-num-masks TIME_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of time masks (or percentage per 100
                           frames when enabled). (type: float, default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage, --no_feats.spec_augment.time-use-num-masks-percentage
                           If true, min/max time-mask counts are interpreted as
                           percentages per 100 frames. (type: bool, default:
                           False)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-prob FREQ_MASK_PROB
                           Probability of applying frequency masking. (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-width FREQ_MASK_MIN_WIDTH
                           Minimum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 0)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-width FREQ_MASK_MAX_WIDTH
                           Maximum frequency-mask width (in bins). (type: int,
                           default: 20)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-min-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MIN_NUM_MASKS
                           Minimum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --feats.spec_augment.freq-mask-max-num-masks FREQ_MASK_MAX_NUM_MASKS
                           Maximum number of frequency masks. (type: int,
                           default: 2)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-method {constant,min,mean}
                           How to choose mask fill value: "constant", "min", or
                           "mean". (default: constant)
     --feats.spec_augment.mask-value MASK_VALUE
                           Fill value used when "--mask-method=constant". (type:
                           float, default: 0.0)

hyperion-plot-embedding-tsne
----------------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.plot_embedding_tsne``.
Support level: **stable**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``matplotlib``, ``scikit-learn``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: plot_embedding_tsne.py --train-v-file TRAIN_V_FILE --train-list
                                 TRAIN_LIST [--pca-var-r PCA_VAR_R]
                                 [--prob-plot PROB_PLOT] [--lnorm] [--unlabeled]
                                 [--plot-class-names PLOT_CLASS_NAMES [PLOT_CLASS_NAMES ...]]
                                 [--title TITLE] [--tsne CONFIG]
                                 [--tsne.tsne-dim TSNE_DIM]
                                 [--tsne.perplexity PERPLEXITY]
                                 [--tsne.early-exaggeration EARLY_EXAGGERATION]
                                 [--tsne.lr LR] [--tsne.num-iter NUM_ITER]
                                 [--tsne.num-iter-without-progress NUM_ITER_WITHOUT_PROGRESS]
                                 [--tsne.min-grad-norm MIN_GRAD_NORM]
                                 [--tsne.metric {cosine,euclidean,l1,l2,precomputed}]
                                 [--tsne.init {random,pca}]
                                 [--tsne.method {barnes_hut,exact}]
                                 [--tsne.angle ANGLE] [--tsne.num-jobs NUM_JOBS]
                                 [--tsne.rng-seed RNG_SEED]
                                 [--max-classes MAX_CLASSES] --output-dir
                                 OUTPUT_DIR [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Projects embeddings using TSNE

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --train-v-file TRAIN_V_FILE
                           Input embeddings rspecifier/file. (required)
     --train-list TRAIN_LIST
                           Segments file with ids and class labels. (required)
     --pca-var-r PCA_VAR_R
                           PCA explained-variance ratio; set >=1 to disable PCA.
                           (type: float, default: 0.95)
     --prob-plot PROB_PLOT
                           Probability of plotting each sample point. (type:
                           float, default: 0.1)
     --lnorm, --no_lnorm   Apply length normalization before PCA/t-SNE. (type:
                           bool, default: False)
     --unlabeled, --no_unlabeled
                           Ignore class labels and plot a single unlabeled cloud.
                           (type: bool, default: False)
     --plot-class-names PLOT_CLASS_NAMES [PLOT_CLASS_NAMES ...]
                           Names of class-label columns to plot. (default:
                           ['class_id'])
     --title TITLE         Optional title text used in generated plots. (default:
                           )
     --tsne CONFIG         Path to a configuration file.
     --max-classes MAX_CLASSES
                           Maximum number of classes to plot. (type: int,
                           default: null)
     --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                           Output directory for generated t-SNE plot files.
                           (required)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug.
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

     --tsne.tsne-dim TSNE_DIM
                           tsne dimension (type: int, default: 2)
     --tsne.perplexity PERPLEXITY
                           tsne perplexity (type: float, default: 30.0)
     --tsne.early-exaggeration EARLY_EXAGGERATION
                           controls how tight natural clusters in the original
                           spaceare in the embedded space and how much space will
                           be between them. (type: float, default: 12.0)
     --tsne.lr LR          learning rate for t-sne (type: float, default: 200.0)
     --tsne.num-iter NUM_ITER
                           max. number of iterations (type: int, default: 1000)
     --tsne.num-iter-without-progress NUM_ITER_WITHOUT_PROGRESS
                           max. number of iterations without improvement (type:
                           int, default: 300)
     --tsne.min-grad-norm MIN_GRAD_NORM
                           minimum gradient norm to stop optim. (type: float,
                           default: 1e-07)
     --tsne.metric {cosine,euclidean,l1,l2,precomputed}
                           distance metric (default: euclidean)
     --tsne.init {random,pca}
                           initialization method (default: random)
     --tsne.method {barnes_hut,exact}
                           gradient calculation method (default: barnes_hut)
     --tsne.angle ANGLE    angle thetha in Barnes-Hut TSNE (type: float, default:
                           0.5)
     --tsne.num-jobs NUM_JOBS
                           num parallel jobs for NN search (type: int, default:
                           1)
     --tsne.rng-seed RNG_SEED
                           random seed (type: int, default: 1234)

     --do-ahc, --no_do-ahc

hyperion-preprocess-audio-files
-------------------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.preprocess_audio_files``.
Support level: **stable**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``audio backend``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: preprocess_audio_files.py [--cfg CFG] [--dataset DATASET]
                                    [--segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE]
                                    [--recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE]
                                    --output-path OUTPUT_PATH
                                    [--output-dataset OUTPUT_DATASET]
                                    [--output-segments-file OUTPUT_SEGMENTS_FILE]
                                    [--output-recordings-file OUTPUT_RECORDINGS_FILE]
                                    [--write-time-durs WRITE_TIME_DURS_SPEC]
                                    [--vad VAD_SPEC]
                                    [--vad-path-prefix VAD_PATH_PREFIX]
                                    [--vad-fs VAD_FS]
                                    [--vad-dilation VAD_DILATION]
                                    [--vad-erosion VAD_EROSION]
                                    [--wav-scale WAV_SCALE] [--part-idx PART_IDX]
                                    [--num-parts NUM_PARTS]
                                    [--audio-format {flac,ogg,wav}]
                                    [--audio-subtype {pcm_16,pcm_24,pcm_32,float,double,vorbis}]
                                    [--remove-dc-offset]
                                    [--target-sample-freq TARGET_SAMPLE_FREQ]
                                    [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   Process audio entries from a Hyperion dataset or recordings table, optionally
   apply VAD and resampling, and write outputs.

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Configuration file in jsonargparse format.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --dataset DATASET     Input Hyperion dataset. (default: null)
     --segments-file SEGMENTS_FILE
                           Optional Hyperion segments file. Used only when
                           --recordings-file is provided; ignored when --dataset
                           is provided. (default: null)
     --recordings-file RECORDINGS_FILE
                           Hyperion recordings file. Required when --dataset is
                           not provided; ignored when --dataset is provided.
                           (default: null)
     --output-path OUTPUT_PATH
                           Directory or base path where audio files will be
                           written. (required)
     --output-dataset OUTPUT_DATASET
                           Optional Hyperion output dataset file. When set,
                           defaults --output-recordings-file/--output-segments-
                           file based on table separator. (default: null)
     --output-segments-file OUTPUT_SEGMENTS_FILE
                           Optional Hyperion output segments file. If omitted and
                           --output-dataset is set, defaults to
                           output_dataset/segments.csv or .tsv. (default: null)
     --output-recordings-file OUTPUT_RECORDINGS_FILE
                           Optional Hyperion output recordings file. Required
                           when --output-dataset is not provided; defaults to
                           output_dataset/recordings.csv or .tsv. (default: null)
     --write-time-durs WRITE_TIME_DURS_SPEC
                           Write per-utterance durations (seconds) to this file.
                           (default: null)
     --vad VAD_SPEC        VAD source spec (e.g., scp/ark). If set, trims audio
                           to speech. (default: null)
     --vad-path-prefix VAD_PATH_PREFIX
                           Prefix to prepend to VAD file paths in scp files.
                           (default: null)
     --vad-fs VAD_FS       VAD frame rate in Hz. (type: float, default: 100)
     --vad-dilation VAD_DILATION
                           Dilate VAD mask by this many seconds. (type: float,
                           default: 0)
     --vad-erosion VAD_EROSION
                           Erode VAD mask by this many seconds (after dilation).
                           (type: float, default: 0)
     --wav-scale WAV_SCALE
                           multiplicative factor for waveform (type: float,
                           default: 1.0)
     --part-idx PART_IDX   splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --num-parts NUM_PARTS
                           splits the list of files into num-parts and processes
                           part-idx (type: int, default: 1)
     --audio-format {flac,ogg,wav}
                           ouput audio format (default: flac)
     --audio-subtype {pcm_16,pcm_24,pcm_32,float,double,vorbis}
                           coding format for audio file (default: null)
     --remove-dc-offset    Remove DC offset from audio before writing. (default:
                           False)
     --target-sample-freq TARGET_SAMPLE_FREQ
                           Resample audio to this sample rate (Hz). (type: float,
                           default: null)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level (0=errors, 3=debug). (type: <function
                           <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

   Split speakers in dataset into test speaker to create ASV trials and cohort
   speakers for S-Norm

     --data-dir DATA_DIR   Path to dataset (required)

                           default: 1000)

                           bool, default: True)

                           Path to output trials dataset (default: null)

hyperion-submit
---------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.hyperion_submit``.
Support level: **stable**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``Slurm (slurm backend only)``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: hyperion_submit.py {local,slurm} ...

   Run Hyperion recipe commands locally or through Slurm

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.

   subcommands:
     For more details of each subcommand, add it as an argument followed by
     --help.

     Available subcommands:
                           (required)
       local
       slurm

hyperion-submit local
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

.. code-block:: text

   usage: hyperion_submit.py [options] local [--cfg CFG] --output-file
                                             OUTPUT_FILE [--num-gpus NUM_GPUS]
                                             [--num-threads NUM_THREADS]
                                             [--mem MEM | --mem-per-cpu MEM_PER_CPU]
                                             [--time TIME] [--array ARRAY]
                                             [--max-jobs-run MAX_JOBS_RUN]
                                             [-v {0,1,2,3}]
                                             [--sbatch-command SBATCH_COMMAND]
                                             [--base-options [ITEM,...]]
                                             [--cpu-options [ITEM,...]]
                                             [--gpu-types GPU_TYPES]
                                             [--default-gpu-type DEFAULT_GPU_TYPE]
                                             ...

   positional arguments:
     command               command after --

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             YAML submitter config
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                           combined stdout/stderr log (required)
     --num-gpus NUM_GPUS   GPUs per task (type: int, default: 0)
     --num-threads NUM_THREADS
                           CPU threads per task (type: int, default: 1)
     --mem MEM             total memory per node (default: null)
     --mem-per-cpu MEM_PER_CPU
                           memory per allocated CPU (default: null)
     --time TIME           wall-clock limit (default: null)
     --array ARRAY         array range NAME=START:END (default: null)
     --max-jobs-run MAX_JOBS_RUN
                           maximum running array tasks (type: int, default: null)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)
     --sbatch-command SBATCH_COMMAND
                           (default: sbatch)
     --base-options [ITEM,...]
                           (type: <class 'list'>, default: [])
     --cpu-options [ITEM,...]
                           (type: <class 'list'>, default: [])
     --gpu-types GPU_TYPES
                           (type: <class 'dict'>, default: {})
     --default-gpu-type DEFAULT_GPU_TYPE
                           (default: null)

hyperion-tables cat
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

.. code-block:: text

   usage: hyperion_tables.py [options] cat [--cfg CFG]
                                           [--input-files INPUT_FILES [INPUT_FILES ...]]
                                           --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                                           [--num-tables NUM_TABLES]
                                           [--base-idx BASE_IDX] [--skip-missing]
                                           [--table-type {segments,recordings,features,vads,diarizations,classes,enrollments,generic}]
                                           [-v {0,1,2,3}]

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             configuration file in YAML format
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --input-files INPUT_FILES [INPUT_FILES ...]
                           optional list of input files (default: null)
     --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                           output file, if input-files is None, input files names
                           are derived from it (required)
     --num-tables NUM_TABLES
                           number of jobs we used to create the individual tables
                           (type: int, default: 0)
     --base-idx BASE_IDX   index of the first job, typically 0 or 1 (type: int,
                           default: 1)
     --skip-missing, --no_skip-missing
                           skip missing input files instead of raising an error
                           (type: bool, default: False)
     --table-type {segments,recordings,features,vads,diarizations,classes,enrollments,generic}
                           Type of table in ['segments', 'recordings',
                           'features', 'vads', 'diarizations', 'classes',
                           'enrollments', 'generic'] (default: generic)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug.
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

hyperion-tables filter
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

.. code-block:: text

   usage: hyperion_tables.py [options] filter [--cfg CFG] --input-file INPUT_FILE

                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.
     --input-file INPUT_FILE
                           input table file (required)
     --x-column X_COLUMN   column for x-axis (required)
     --y-column Y_COLUMN   column for y-axis (required)
     --z-column Z_COLUMN   column for z-axis (required)
     --color {C0,C1,C2,C3,C4,C5,C6,C7,C8,C9,r,g,b,c,m,y,k}
                           matplotlib color for points (default: C0)
     --marker {o,s,^,v,x,+,*,d,.}
                           matplotlib marker style for points (default: o)
     --sample-frac SAMPLE_FRAC
                           fraction of points to sample randomly (0,1] (type:
                           float, default: 1.0)
     --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                           output image file; if not set, the plot is shown
                           (default: null)
     --dropna, --no_dropna
                           drop NA values before plotting (type: bool, default:
                           True)
     --table-type {segments,recordings,features,vads,diarizations,classes,enrollments,generic}
                           Type of table in ['segments', 'recordings',
                           'features', 'vads', 'diarizations', 'classes',
                           'enrollments', 'generic'] (default: generic)
     -v {0,1,2,3}, --verbose {0,1,2,3}
                           Verbosity level: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug.
                           (type: <function <lambda> at <address>>, default: 1)

hyperion-train-dac
------------------

Module: ``hyperion.bin.train_dac``.
Support level: **experimental**.
Conditional runtime requirements: ``PyTorch``, ``codec training data``.

.. code-block:: text

   usage: train_dac.py [--cfg CFG] {dac,streaming_dac} ...

   Train DAC model

   options:
     -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
     --cfg CFG             Path to a configuration file.
     --print_config [=flags]
                           Print the configuration after applying all other
                           arguments and exit. The optional flags customizes the
                           output and are one or more keywords separated by
                           comma. The supported flags are: skip_default,
                           skip_unset.

   subcommands:
     For more details of each subcommand, add it as an argument followed by
     --help.

     Available subcommands:
                           (required)
       dac
       streaming_dac

                           recordings manifest file (kaldi .scp or pandas .csv)

                           argument has to be sync with tokenizer_files.
                           (default: null)
     --data.train.dataset.tokenizer-files TOKENIZER_FILES [TOKENIZER_FILES ...]

                           sync with tokenizer_mappings. (default: null)

     --data.train.dataset.num-augs NUM_AUGS
                           number of augmentations per segment and augmentation
                           type (type: int, default: 1)
     --data.train.dataset.num-aug-mix NUM_AUG_MIX
                           number of AugMix augmentations per segment (type: int,
                           default: 0)

                           number of AugMix augmentations per segment (type:

     --data.train.dataset.target-sample-freq TARGET_SAMPLE_FREQ
                           target sampling frequencey, if not None all audios are

                           random seed (type: int, default: 11235811)

                           Type of sampler to use. Determines the batching and

                           Maximum chunk duration in seconds. If not set, equals

                           Minimum overlap in seconds between consecutive chunks

                           Strategy for sampling chunk lengths. 'uniform' draws

                           Number of chunks to extract per segment in a single

                           Exponent to apply when transforming class weights

                           How to assign weights to classes. 'data-prior' uses
